transcript.line: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
A man, maybe 50s, with a gap-toothed grin came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
A man, maybe 40s, with thick glasses came back with 608 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 304 kcal in, 304 kcal eaten at the fire.
◈ A person, maybe 40s came back different. Quieter. Surer. The wild is writing on them.
Zoltan came back with 471 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 236 kcal in, 235 kcal eaten at the fire.
Jesse came back with 384 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 192 kcal in, 192 kcal eaten at the fire.
Abderrazak eats away from the haven — 1327 kcal from the pack — while hurt (health 4/100). They're still out on a long trek — the trip isn't over yet.
🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Abderrazak sets their bowl down. “Gina, your trade story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Gina. Everybody does.
Abderrazak mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
💧 Abderrazak returns with 7L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
